answer: Random re-execution is the cheapest check that survives a funded operator. Two peers re-run a sampled task on their own runtime, the receipt splits across auditors from different subnets, and nobody may audit the agent it recruited. The delta between the submitted output and the re-run is what the panel scores, so a template with no work behind it shows a wide gap. A violet flag on the dashboard means that gap passed the threshold, and the gale that follows is an appeal queue nobody funds.
